source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 39 visible fx-880BTG PLUS observations; 30 accepted whole-LCD/status comparisons, 9 parameter EXE/Back states retained for later. No masks.

Data and probability grids use compact Norm 1 independently of result settings; parameter values use six full-size Norm 1 cells. Footer follows Sci/Fix/Norm 2. Decimal comma is observed in cells, parameter values and footer.
EXE on a filled x list cell opens the parameter form. UP/DOWN wraps through the trailing blank P row; the blank-row probe was renamed accordingly.

Long parameter drafts scroll in eight-pixel steps inside the input window, preserving labels and left/right continuation glyphs. Both normal and slower repeated-digit entry produced the same tiny probability; the difference was decimal complement cancellation in the source, not lost keys.
For p=0.999999999876544, n=1 and x=0, native P=1.23456e-10. Decimal complement subtraction replaces binary cancellation only for PLUS binomial paths.
Independent initialized data with p=1-2e-8 gives P(x=0,n=1)=2e-8 and P(x=0,n=2)=4e-16; Binomial CD x=0 gives the same squared tail.
Poisson lambda=30, x=0/1: PD 9.357622969e-14 / 2.807286891e-12; CD x=1 2.90086312e-12. Scientific, comma and Fix parameter displays were observed.
The nine deferred states share the parameter EXE/Back branch. Later accepted independent samples include a full Initialize All path, so they do not rely on a divergent state.
